translations.web: There is salvation in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven that is given among men, by which we must be saved!”
translations.bsb: Salvation exists in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven given to men by which we must be saved.”
translations.kjv: Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.
translations.asv: And in none other is there salvation: for neither is there any other name under heaven, that is given among men, wherein we must be saved.
